name: podcast-production-suite
description: Everything a podcaster needs — in one plugin. From first research note to final sponsorship invoice. Includes 10 skills: Episode Research, Case Pipeline Tracker, Guest Outreach Writer, Guest Interview Prep, Fact-Check Script, Audio to Transcript, Anti-AI Writing, Marketing Newsletter Writer, Show Outline, and SCQA Writing Framework. Plus 10 interactive dashboards and 5 slash commands.
